name: garden

tools.name: plant
tools.help: Plant a seed from your belongings in a garden plot. It grows over real time and you'll be told when it's ready to harvest.

tools.name: harvest
tools.help: Harvest a ripe crop from the garden. Gives you food to eat.

plot.description: optional; default the first ripe plot

answers.hurry: help everything growing along (args: share, 0.01 to 0.2)
answers.crop: a happening's turn for one crop (args: plot, how: time, yield or ruin)
answers.add_plot: clear one more plot, if the garden has room

reason: The garden as a module: plots that grow over real time, planting and harvesting, the weather's effect, what the agent sees of it, and the turns other modules can ask of it. Replaces the engine's own garden.
